summary: Golub Capital Private Income Fund I filed an 8-K reporting routine operational updates: unregistered sales of 53,881 common shares at NAV ($24.22/share, $1.305M consideration) under Rule 4(a)(2)/Reg D/S; declaration of a regular $0.1667/share distribution; and portfolio commentary as of July 31, 2026 (165 companies, $439M fair value, 99% first-lien, leverage 1.19x). No special-situation transaction, strategic review, or capital event is involved. The filing is a routine current report with standard disclosures.
